name: Starship V3 Command Section
description: Flight 12 V3 nose, payload section, avionics and forward flaps. Geometry and mass allocation are restricted public-data engineering estimates. nose_radius_m and axial_drag_coefficient are calibrated engineering estimates: the 3.0 m stagnation radius matches the same 9 m ogive modelled by starship_command, and 0.45 is a slender-body axial Cd on the frontal area for a fineness ratio near 14 (Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3); the transonic rise is applied separately by AerodynamicsModel.GetMachDragMultiplier. Body-flap planforms (hinge station, length, span) are image-derived estimates from Flight 7 proportions; deflection range and servo rate are simulator estimates. Carries the LOX header tank (23.5 t, calibrated) above the nose-cone base; header propellant feeds the engines once the main tanks are empty or vented.
